subject: Quote request: automating onboarding for ~40 new hires a month
text:
Hi Alex,

We're a 120-person analytics firm and we onboard roughly 40 people a month. Today HR copies data between BambooHR, Google Workspace and Slack by hand and it takes about two days per hire.

Could you send a rough quote and timeline for automating this? We'd like something live before our January intake. Happy to jump on a call Thursday or Friday.

Best,
Priya Nandakumar
Head of People Ops, Lumenforge Analytics
